description.en: Cost reported by Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads, converted to TRY at the day’s TCMB rate.
description.tr: Google Ads, Meta Ads ve TikTok Ads’in bildirdiği maliyet; günün TCMB kuruyla TRY’ye çevrilir.

ad_spend.sql_example:
-- metric ad_spend v1
SELECT
  SUM(ad_spend) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  AND channel IN ('google_ads', 'meta_ads', 'tiktok_ads')

description.en: Revenue divided by orders, both from the back office.
description.tr: Ciro bölü sipariş; ikisi de arka ofisten.

aov.sql_example:
-- metric aov v1
SELECT
  SUM(revenue) AS numerator,
  SUM(orders) AS denominator,
  SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(orders), 0) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'

description.en: Back-office orders divided by GA4 sessions. By channel, orders take the channel stored with the order and sessions the GA4 session source.
description.tr: Arka ofis siparişleri bölü GA4 oturumları. Kanal kırılımında sipariş, siparişle kaydedilen kanala; oturum, GA4 oturum kaynağına göre atanır.

conversion_rate.sql_example:
-- metric conversion_rate v2
SELECT
  SUM(orders) AS numerator,
  SUM(sessions) AS denominator,
  SUM(orders) / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'

description.en: Channel spend divided by back-office orders attributed to that channel (last non-direct click).
description.tr: Kanal harcaması bölü o kanala atanan arka ofis siparişleri (son doğrudan olmayan tıklama).

cpa.sql_example:
-- metric cpa v1
SELECT
  SUM(ad_spend) AS numerator,
  SUM(orders) AS denominator,
  SUM(ad_spend) / NULLIF(SUM(orders), 0) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  AND channel IN ('google_ads', 'meta_ads', 'tiktok_ads')

description.en: Purchase events in the GA4 BigQuery export, counted once per transaction_id.
description.tr: GA4 BigQuery dışa aktarımındaki purchase etkinlikleri; her transaction_id bir kez sayılır.

label.tr: GA4 satın almaları ile arka ofis siparişleri

ga4_purchases.sql_example:
-- metric ga4_purchases v2
SELECT
  SUM(ga4_purchases) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'

description.en: Purchase revenue in TRY from GA4 purchase events, counted once per transaction_id.
description.tr: GA4 purchase etkinliklerinden TRY satın alma geliri; her transaction_id bir kez sayılır.

label.tr: GA4 geliri ile arka ofis cirosu

ga4_revenue.sql_example:
-- metric ga4_revenue v1
SELECT
  SUM(ga4_revenue) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'

description.en: Orders placed in the back office, by order date in Europe/Istanbul time. Test orders are excluded; cancelled orders are kept.
description.tr: Arka ofiste oluşan siparişler, İstanbul saatine göre sipariş tarihinde. Test siparişleri hariç, iptal edilen siparişler dahildir.

label.tr: GA4 satın almaları ile arka ofis siparişleri

orders.sql_example:
-- metric orders v3
SELECT
  SUM(orders) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'

description.en: Conversions as Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads report them in their own interfaces, each with its own attribution window.
description.tr: Google Ads, Meta Ads ve TikTok Ads’in kendi arayüzlerinde, kendi atıf pencereleriyle bildirdiği dönüşümler.

platform_conversions.sql_example:
-- metric platform_conversions v1
SELECT
  SUM(platform_conversions) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  AND channel IN ('google_ads', 'meta_ads', 'tiktok_ads')

description.en: Order value in TRY including VAT, excluding shipping, from the back office. Refunds are not subtracted.
description.tr: Arka ofisten, KDV dahil ve kargo hariç TRY sipariş tutarı. İadeler düşülmez.

label.tr: GA4 geliri ile arka ofis cirosu

revenue.sql_example:
-- metric revenue v2
SELECT
  SUM(revenue) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'

description.en: Back-office revenue from orders whose last non-direct click came from the channel, divided by that channel’s spend. Platform-reported conversions are not used.
description.tr: Son doğrudan olmayan tıklaması kanaldan gelen siparişlerin arka ofis cirosu, bölü o kanalın harcaması. Platformların bildirdiği dönüşümler kullanılmaz.

roas.sql_example:
-- metric roas v2
SELECT
  SUM(revenue) AS numerator,
  SUM(ad_spend) AS denominator,
  SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
  AND channel IN ('google_ads', 'meta_ads', 'tiktok_ads')

description.en: GA4 sessions: distinct user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id pairs in the BigQuery export, on the day the session starts.
description.tr: GA4 oturumları: BigQuery dışa aktarımındaki benzersiz user_pseudo_id ve ga_session_id çiftleri; oturumun başladığı güne yazılır.

sessions.sql_example:
-- metric sessions v1
SELECT
  SUM(sessions) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
